Simulated: Runbook response to PERMISSION_MISSING: confirm which scope is missing (pages_manage_posts) and ask the Page owner to restore the admin role. Not carried out - there is no real Page or owner behind this mock account.
Simulated: Runbook response, next step: once the admin role is restored, reconnect so pages_manage_posts is re-granted. Not carried out - the scenario script clears the anomaly on the next day.

Simulated: Runbook response to TOKEN_EXPIRED: re-authorise to mint a new access token and investigate why the refresh did not run. Not carried out - no real token exists; the scenario script clears the anomaly on the next day.
Simulated: Runbook response to ACCOUNT_RESTRICTED: pause tests that use TT-002 and re-check for 48h before replacing it. Not carried out.

Simulated: Runbook response to DISCONNECTED: reconnect through the proposed connection workflow. Not carried out - no UI reconnection was performed; the scenario script clears the anomaly on the next day.
Simulated: Runbook response to TOKEN_EXPIRING_SOON: re-authorise before the token expires. Not carried out.
Simulated: Runbook response when a restriction lasts more than 48h: retire the account with `account retire TT-002` and request a standby TikTok test account. Not carried out.
Simulated: Runbook response to ASSET_MISSING: check whether the Page was unlinked or the connected user lost access. Not carried out; issue left open.
